name: Ukuvimbela inzalo
tagline: Izinketho zakho. Yini mahhala. Yini evumelana nempilo yakho.

what_is_it.heading: Ukuvimbela inzalo ngamagama alula
what_is_it.lede: Ukuvimbela inzalo kukuvumela ukuthi ukhethe ukuthi unezingane nini futhi nini. INingizimu Afrika ihlinzeka ngezinhlobo eziningi zezindlela - eziningi zimahhala emitholampilo kahulumeni. Izindlela ezehlukene zifanela izimpilo ezahlukene.
paragraphs: Ayikho indlela 'engcono kakhulu' — kuphela ekulungele wena njengamanje. Izinketho zincike eminyakeni yakho, impilo, izinhlelo zezingane, isimo somlingani, nendlela yokuphila. Indlela efanele yileyo ozoyisebenzisa ngokuqhubekayo.

Yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka ngokuvimbela inzalo mahhala. Awudingi ukufaka umlingani wakho, abazali (kusukela eminyakeni eyi-12), nanoma ubani omunye. Ukugcinwa kuyimfihlo kuvikelwe umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika - abasebenzi bezempilo abakwazi ukwabelana nokukhetha kwakho ukuvimbela inzalo ngaphandle kwemvume yakho.

items.headline: Konke kumahhala
items.body: Amaphilisi, imijovo, izimila, ama-IUD, amakhondomu - konke kutholakala mahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni.

items.headline: Izinketho eziningi
items.body: Amaphilisi ansuku zonke, imijovo yanyanga zonke, imijovo yezinyanga ezi-3, izimila ezihlala iminyaka emi-3, ama-IUD ahlala iminyaka efika kweyi-10.

items.headline: Kuyimfihlo
items.body: Kusukela eminyakeni eyi-12 ungakwazi ukufinyelela ukuvimbela inzalo ngasese. Abasebenzi bezempilo abakwazi ukutshela abazali noma abalingani ngaphandle kwemvume yakho.

items.headline: Iphilisi eliphuthumayo
items.body: Iphilisi lasekuseni lisebenza kuze kube yizinsuku ezingu-5 ngemva kocansi — kodwa ngokushesha kuba ngcono. Kumahhala emitholampilo, etholakala emakhemisi amaningi.

pull_quote.text: Amakhondomu kuphela avikela kukho kokubili ukukhulelwa KANYE NEZIFO ezithelelana ngokocansi. Izindlela zamahomoni zisebenza kahle kakhulu ekukhulelweni kodwa azinikezi ukuvikeleka ezifweni. Phinda kabili uma ukwazi.

signs.heading: Iyiphi indlela evumelana nempilo yakho?
signs.lede: Ayikho impendulo eyodwa efanele. Fanisa indlela nempilo yakho — futhi khumbula ukuthi ungashintsha noma nini.

items.title: Ufuna isikhathi eside, umzamo omncane
items.description: Faka (iminyaka emi-3, induku encane engalweni engenhla) noma i-IUD (iminyaka engu-3-10 kuye ngohlobo). Zombili zisebenza kahle kakhulu futhi ungakhohlwa ngazo uma sezikhona.

items.title: Ufuna ukulawula kwanyanga zonke
items.description: Iphilisi (elithathwa nsuku zonke ngesikhathi esifanayo) noma umjovo (ngenyanga noma 3-ngenyanga). Kuhle uma ungase ufune ukukhulelwa onyakeni olandelayo noma emibili.

items.title: Ufuna ukuvikelwa kwe-STI futhi
items.description: Amakhondomu abesilisa noma abesifazane - ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngezinye izindlela zokuvimbela inzalo noma ngaphandle kwazo. Yilezi kuphela ezivikela i-HIV kanye nezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi.

items.fact: Zonke izindlela ezibuyiseleka emuva zivumela ukuzala kwakho kubuye ngemva kokuma - ngokuvamile phakathi nezinyanga. Awukho umthelela wesikhathi eside wokuba nezingane kamuva lapho uzifuna.

items.myth: Awukwazi ukukhulelwa ngesikhathi sakho sokuqala, noma ngenkathi uncelisa.
items.fact: Ungakwazi ngokuphelele. Sebenzisa njalo ukuvimbela inzalo uma ungafuni ukukhulelwa — okokuqala, ukuya esikhathini, nanoma yisiphi isikhathi ngemva kokuzalwa.

items.myth: Iphilisi livikela i-HIV kanye nezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi.
items.fact: I-hormonal contraception ivimbela ukukhulelwa kuphela. Ngezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi kanye ne-HIV - amakhondomu ngaso sonke isikhathi, noma i-PrEP uma esengozini enkulu ye-HIV.

items.myth: Ukuvimbela inzalo okuphuthumayo kuyefana nokukhipha isisu.
items.fact: Ukuvimbela inzalo okuphuthumayo kusebenza ngaphambi kokukhulelwa - kubambezela ukuphuma kweqanda. Akukwazi ukuqeda ukukhulelwa okukhona. Ukunqamula ukukhulelwa kuyinkonzo ehlukile, yezomthetho.

items.title: Iya kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo kahulumeni
items.description: Ngena. Cela ukuvimbela inzalo. Bazochaza izinketho futhi bakusize ukhethe. Akukho ukuqokwa okudingekayo, alukho usizo lwezokwelapha oludingekayo.

items.title: Zama indlela — bese ushintsha uma ingalingani
items.description: Imiphumela engemihle ngendlela eyodwa ayichazi ukuthi ezinye zizokunikeza izinkinga. Abesifazane abaningi bazama 2 noma 3 ngaphambi kokuthola efanele. Ukushintsha kumahhala.

items.title: Uma uphuthelwa iphilisi - hlola ipheshana
items.description: Amaphilisi ahlukene anemithetho ehlukene. Ngokuvamile: phuza iphilisi eligejiwe ngokushesha nje lapho ukhumbula, futhi usebenzise amakhondomu izinsuku eziyi-7 njengesipele.

items.title: Uma kwenzeka ucansi ngaphandle kokuvikela
items.description: Ukuvimbela inzalo okuphuthumayo zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-5. Kumahhala emitholampilo. u-R30–80 emakhemisi amaningi. Ngokushesha kuba ngcono. Ayithathi indawo yokuvimbela inzalo evamile.

items.title: Abashadile — zama ukunquma ndawonye
items.description: Ukuvimbela inzalo kusebenza kangcono uma bobabili abalingani besekela ukukhetha. Imitholampilo eminingi inikeza izithandani ukwelulekwa. Imiphumela iba ngcono uma nisekhasini elifanayo.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Ukuvimbela inzalo kungenye yezinsizakalo zezempilo zomphakathi ezihlelwe kahle eNingizimu Afrika. Kumahhala, kuyimfihlo, kutholakala kuwo wonke umuntu kusukela eminyakeni eyi-12.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka ngokuvimba inzalo mahhala kanye nokwelulekwa
